data.name: medium
text:
torque_spike (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-23.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Girujan, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
NPT: 2.79 h

overpressure (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-28.pdf#p1
cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Barail, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
NPT: 3.72 h

torque_spike (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-05-01.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
NPT: 1.52 h

data.name: low
text:
wellbore_instability (low)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-24.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Girujan, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 1.74 h

data.name: critical
text:
overpressure (critical)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-26.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
remedy: Raised mud weight in 26-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
NPT: 9.13 h

data.name: medium
text:
stuck_pipe (medium)
page: DUL-003_DDR_2015-09-02.pdf#p1
cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick.
remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 66 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 2.1 hrs.
NPT: 2.07 h

mud_loss (medium)
page: DUL-003_DDR_2015-09-07.pdf#p1
cause: Lost circulation 31 bbl/hr while drilling Barail sand, partial returns only.
remedy: Pumped 66 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
NPT: 9.44 h

data.name: high
text:
mud_loss (high)
page: DUL-003_DDR_2015-09-04.pdf#p1
cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 5.6 hrs.
remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.
NPT: 5.64 h

mud_loss (high)
page: DUL-003_DDR_2015-09-07.pdf#p1
cause: Losses seen while running casing through Barail, static losses continuing on connections.
remedy: Spotted 94 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.
NPT: 12.48 h

kick (high)
page: DUL-003_DDR_2015-09-08.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 81 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
NPT: 8.26 h
